stacks.notes: Prefer the existing component system; use refs and scoped effects for motion; keep state ownership explicit.
Keep browser-only animation client-side, preserve server/client boundaries, and verify route transitions after hydration.
Use local composables and component primitives; clean watchers, listeners, and animation instances on unmount.
Prefer native transitions and actions where enough; clean browser-only effects during destroy.
Keep semantics and state ownership explicit; avoid creating a component abstraction for one use.
Use platform primitives, viewing-distance sizing, touch/remote behavior, and device evidence before web patterns.
